# tosijs-ui v1.17.0-beta.3

Simple, robust web-components for use with tosijs or anything else.

- Docs: https://ui.tosijs.net
- Source: https://github.com/tonioloewald/tosijs-ui
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tosijs-ui

## Documentation

Full documentation, with live code examples, is at the links below.

Pages below are also available as plain markdown: append `index.md` to the URL
(for example `/adopting-the-doc-system/index.md`).
Prefer that if you only need the text. A page marked noindex has no markdown copy.

Live examples run inline on the shared page by default (not sandboxed):
each has its own `preview` element, but they share one tosijs module, so
`tosi()` state singletons are shared across every example on a page. This is
deliberate (it shows tosi isolation and lets you drive demos via the global
singleton). Namespace example state with unique top-level keys so examples
don't clobber each other; the `iframe` attribute isolates DOM/CSS, not state.

## Pages

- https://ui.tosijs.net/babylon-3d/ — 3d
  Deprecated: <tosi-3d> is a thin Babylon.js wrapper kept for compatibility. New 3D work should use the tosijs-3d package.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/ab-test/ — ab-test
  <tosi-ab> shows or hides content by condition, so you can run A/B tests or feature flags by setting AbTest.conditions.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/adopting-the-doc-system/ — Adopting the doc system
  A first hour with tosijs-ui/site: the minimum that works, how to tell it is actually working, and the four things that fail silently while the site still serves 200s.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/affix/ — affix
  <tosi-affix> attaches a toolbar, badge or caption to one edge of its content, laid out beside it rather than floated, so it never covers it.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/appendices/ — Appendices
  Upgrading tosijs-ui across breaking releases, and the release-notes tool that builds its changelog from commit messages.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/carousel/ — carousel
  A minimal carousel with optional arrows and dots, several items per page, looping, and auto-advance that holds still while someone is looking.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/code-editor/ — code
  <tosi-code> embeds a CodeMirror 6 editor for JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML and Markdown, with undo, a diff view and a change event.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/color-input/ — color input field
  <tosi-color> is a colour input that also edits opacity, so it can produce translucent colours that the native colour picker cannot.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/components/ — Components
  Custom elements for what HTML lacks or does badly: menus, selects, data tables, dialogs, tabs, code editors and more, built on web standards.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/crud/ — crud
  <tosi-crud> pairs a searchable table with a schema-driven form over a store you supply (REST, IndexedDB or an array) for list-and-edit screens.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/data-client/ — data client
  Open and save a project's data files from a dev-server page, for in-browser tools such as level or scene editors, optionally committing each save.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/dialog/ — dialog
  <tosi-dialog> wraps the native <dialog> element with an OK button, a footer slot, and promise-based alert, confirm and prompt helpers.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/diff/ — diff
  <tosi-diff> shows a unified, line-by-line diff between two strings, with removed and added lines marked, as in a code review.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/doc-browser/ — doc-browser
  createDocBrowser() renders a documentation corpus as a searchable browser with live, self-testing examples: a lighter alternative to Storybook.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/doc-site-system/ — Doc-Site System
  How tosijs-ui's static, pre-rendered, hydrating documentation-site system works — and how to adopt it (tosijs-ui/site) in your own project.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/doc-system/ — doc-system
  <tosi-doc-system> hydrates pre-rendered static doc pages into a fast single-page doc browser, keeping full HTML for search engines and no-JS readers.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/docs/ — docs
  extractDocs() collects markdown files and doc comments from source code into one docs.json corpus, the input to the doc browser and static site.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/documentation-system/ — Documentation System
  tosijs-ui/site: turn markdown and doc comments into a static, pre-rendered documentation site with live, self-testing examples, an ePub and print.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/drag-and-drop/ — drag & drop
  Make HTML5 drag and drop usable: one init() call highlights compatible drop zones as a drag starts, including zones added mid-drag.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/editable-rect/ — editable-rect
  <tosi-editable> adds handles to an absolutely positioned element to move, resize and rotate it, with optional grid and angle snapping.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/component/ — example
  <tosi-example> turns code blocks into live, editable examples with a preview, a console and inline tests, in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML or CSS.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/filter-builder/ — filter
  <tosi-filter> builds array filter functions from a Finder-style query editor, with extensible filter types and a state you can save as JSON.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/float/ — float
  <tosi-float> is a minimally styled floating element that can be dragged, and that hides, stays or is removed when the window resizes.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/form-components/ — Form Components
  Form-associated custom elements — inputs, selects, and editors that participate
- https://ui.tosijs.net/form/ — forms
  <tosi-form> and <tosi-field> build forms with native client-side validation and a submit callback that receives the form's values.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/gamepad/ — gamepads
  Read gamepad and WebXR controller state in a compact form (buttons, triggers, thumbsticks and touch) for games and XR scenes.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/hash-state/ — hash-state
  Key-value state in the page's URL hash: shareable, bookmarkable, and back/forward work
- https://ui.tosijs.net/header/ — header
  <tosi-header> is a flex header bar; compose it with elastic() and spacer() to place a title, links and menus where you want them.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/helper-libraries/ — Helper Libraries
  General purpose utilities and behaviors — routing, theming, localization, sorting, drag-and-drop, and other building ...
- https://ui.tosijs.net/highlight-block/ — highlight-block
  <tosi-highlight> syntax-highlights code that arrives at runtime, such as a fetched snippet or a chat message, without loading a code editor.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/highlight-styles/ — highlight-styles
  The syntax-highlighting token colours as a stylesheet you can import and retheme, for code highlighted outside <tosi-highlight>.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/icon-composition/ — Icon Composition
  Experiment with the icon composition language: stack, recolour, rotate, scale and offset icons with short suffixes on their names.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/icons/ — icons
  SVG icons as element creators (icons.chevronDown()), themeable with CSS variables, with a small language for composing new icons from old.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/icon-svg/ — iconSvg — icon markup without a DOM
  iconSvg() returns an icon's SVG markup as a string and iconNames() lists them, with no DOM, for build scripts, server templates and ePubs.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/layout/ — layout
  <tosi-row>, <tosi-column> and <tosi-grid>: thin custom elements over CSS flexbox and grid for structural page layout.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/live-theme/ — live-theme
  A live theme editor: adjust tosijs-ui theme colours and watch every component update instantly, then read or set the values from code.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/localize/ — localize
  Localize an interface: localize() for strings, <tosi-localized> for markup, and <tosi-locale-picker> so readers can choose the language.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/bodymovin-player/ — lottie / bodymovin
  <tosi-lottie> plays Lottie (bodymovin) animations like an <img>: set src or json, and use the bodymovin API through its animation property.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/make-icon-data/ — make-icon-data
  A build tool that turns folders of SVG files into the icon-data module behind the tosijs-ui icon system, optimizing the paths as it goes.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/make-sorter/ — makeSorter
  Build an array sort callback from a function that returns the keys to sort by, with a direction per key, so a multi-key sort is one line.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/mapbox/ — map
  Embed an interactive Mapbox GL map as a custom element: set the token, style and coordinates as attributes, and use the map object for the rest.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/markdown-viewer/ — markdown
  <tosi-md> renders markdown from a src URL or from its own text, sanitizing the HTML by default, so you can show markdown anywhere on a page.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/menu/ — menu
  Pop up a menu anywhere with popMenu() or <tosi-menu>: nested submenus, icons, keyboard shortcuts, and drop menus that accept drags.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/migrating/ — Migrating from older versions
  Breaking changes in tosijs-ui releases and what to change when you upgrade past them, from the xinjs-ui rename to the current release.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/month/ — month
  <tosi-month> shows a calendar month and, when selectable, lets readers pick a date or a date range: a friendlier date picker.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/natural-compare/ — naturalCompare
  Comparing values the way a reader expects, for sorting tables, navs and lists.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/notifications/ — notifications
  postNotification() shows stacked toast notifications: info, success, warning, error or progress, timed or persistent, newest on top.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/one-source-every-artifact/ — One Source
  How one corpus of doc comments and markdown becomes a static SEO site, a live playground, an ePub, a PDF and llms.txt from a single build.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/palette/ — palette
  <tosi-palette> is a command palette: a search field that opens a keyboard-driven modal of ranked results from sources you supply.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/password-strength/ — password strength
  Wrap an <input> in <tosi-password-strength> to rate a password as it is typed and securely check whether it appears in known breaches.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/pocket-bar/ — pocket bar
  A **pocket toolbar**: a single icon at rest that expands into a bar of your controls
- https://ui.tosijs.net/pop-float/ — popFloat
  popFloat() pops a floating element up beside a target, placing it to stay on screen, for popovers, pickers and other one-off overlays.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/rating/ — rating
  <tosi-rating> is a form-associated rating input drawn with icons, with half steps, custom icons and sizes, that behaves like an <input>.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/release-notes/ — release-notes
  tosijs-release-notes builds CHANGELOG sections from tagged bullets in commit messages, and fails a release when one is left unwritten.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/rich-text/ — rich text
  <tosi-rich-text> is a small, extensible WYSIWYG editor with a customizable toolbar, editing its own contents or a value you set.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/router/ — router
  A lightweight client-side router for single-page apps, with named parameters, hash routing, and several named views per route.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/schema-form/ — schema-form
  <tosi-schema-form> builds an editable, validated form from a JSON Schema, keeping its value, not the inputs, as the source of truth.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/via-tag/ — scriptTag & styleSheet
  scriptTag() and styleSheet() load a classic script or stylesheet from a CDN and return a promise, much like import() for older libraries.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/search-field/ — search-field
  <tosi-search-field> suggests refinements as you type and turns them into tags, for Finder-style searches with power operators.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/segmented/ — segmented select
  <tosi-segmented> is a form-associated segmented control for choosing one value or several, with icons and labels.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/select/ — select
  <tosi-select> replaces <select> with a styleable menu that supports icons, separators, submenus, editable values and missing options.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/side-nav/ — sidebar
  <tosi-sidenav> shows a sidebar beside the content when there is room and hides it behind a toggle on small screens, as iPad apps do.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/size-break/ — size-break
  <tosi-sizebreak> swaps content by available size, such as a row of buttons that becomes a menu when space runs out.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/sizer/ — sizer
  <tosi-sizer> adds a bottom-right resize handle to a fixed-size element, so readers can drag it to a new size.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/data-table/ — table
  A virtual data table for very large datasets: sortable, resizable, pinnable columns inferred from the data, keyboard navigation and row detail.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/tab-selector/ — tabs
  <tosi-tabs> builds a tab panel from its children's name attributes, with closeable tabs and methods to add or remove tabs.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/tag-list/ — tag-list
  An editable list of tags with suggestions, built on standard inputs and form-associated, so it submits like any other field.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/theme/ — theme
  The tosijs-ui theme: CSS variables for spacing, colour and type shared by every component, with dark mode computed from your colours.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/tooltip/ — tooltip
  Replace native title tooltips with styled ones that render markdown: call initTooltips() once, then use data-tooltip or title.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/ — tosijs-ui
  A small, fast library of standards-based web components (data tables, dialogs, forms, rich text, carousels, and more) built on tosijs — smaller and faster than a React app, with no virtual DOM.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/track-drag/ — trackDrag
  trackDrag() follows a mouse or touch drag with one callback that reports the offset, for resize handles, sliders and draggable parts.
- https://ui.tosijs.net/value-renderer/ — valueRenderer
  valueRenderer() turns a short type string into a formatter for numbers, currency, bytes or booleans, each with a default alignment.
